round1_artifacts_stay_byte_frozen: xval/XVAL-LBM-NO-MCMP-TWO-PHASE-ONLY/{predeclared.json,posthoc_addendum.json,results.json,REPORT.md} are NOT modified by round 3. No round-1 threshold is relaxed, no round-1 FAIL is re-scored.
gap_being_closed: Round 1 declared, verbatim in its REPORT.md section 5: 'The phase indicator is frozen. ... Nothing here validates interface dynamics, coalescence or any flow with a non-zero normal velocity at the interface.' The OSS row's borrowable piece is a phase-field (Allen-Cahn) layered initialisation plus the variable-density equilibrium assembly, so the frozen indicator is a *simplification* of the OSS route, not the OSS route. Round 3 replaces the frozen indicator by an Allen-Cahn-evolved phase field (M2P-E) and measures what the simplification cost.
alternatives: P1 frozen indicator (round-1 model M2P) - kept as the control arm at identical settings

P2 Allen-Cahn-evolved phase field advected by the LBM velocity, conservative flux form div(phi u) from tensorlbm.phasefield.operators, relaxation -M mu with double-well params (beta, kappa) inverted from (sigma, W) by tensorlbm.allen_cahn_lbm.free_energy_parameters
P3 exact shear-translation solution of the pure advection equation (analytic; used to verify the advection operator itself, no LBM in the loop)

hypothesis.H-R3-1: With the interface free to evolve, the layered Poiseuille profile stays inside the owner 15% band for viscosity ratios <= 4 at width 2, i.e. the frozen assumption is not load-bearing for the *profile*.
hypothesis.H-R3-2: In a strictly parallel body-force-driven channel the Allen-Cahn interface does not migrate: |interface centre shift| <= 1 lattice cell and the 10-90 width does not grow by more than 50%, so the round-1 frozen convention costs at most one cell of interface position.
hypothesis.H-R3-3: The Allen-Cahn advection term is second order in space and time, i.e. the exact shear-translation solution is reproduced with an observed convergence order p >= 1.5.

threshold_rationale.E1_l2_rel: the owner acceptance band, unchanged from round 1 (no relaxation).
threshold_rationale.E2_max_rel_peak: owner acceptance band, unchanged from round 1.
threshold_rationale.E3_interface_centre_shift_cells: one lattice cell is the resolution at which the round-1 indicator fixes the interface; a migration beyond it means the frozen geometry was materially wrong.
threshold_rationale.E3_interface_width_growth_rel: 50% growth of the 10-90 width over the whole transient; the AC equilibrium width is W=2 cells and the tanh initial profile is that equilibrium, so any growth is a discretisation/diffusion artefact.
threshold_rationale.E4_uy_spurious_rel: identical to round-1 K5 (1%) so the two rounds are directly comparable.
threshold_rationale.E5_phase_field_budget_rel: the flux-form advection conserves the phase-field integral exactly in the continuum for div u = 0; 1e-3 is the float32 accumulation floor for ~1e4 steps, i.e. the check is a conservation check, not a physics band.
threshold_rationale.E6_shear_translation_l2_rel: 5% of the profile L2 norm - the exact solution is analytic and the discretisation is central-difference, so anything above 5% would indicate a mis-paired flux/derivative axis rather than discretisation error.
threshold_rationale.E6_observed_order_min: a second-order scheme must show at least p=1.5 after one refinement; below that the advective term is not second order.
threshold_rationale.E7_degradation_vs_frozen_l2_abs: 0.05 absolute L2 (i.e. roughly one third of the band) allows the evolving interface to cost something but not to be a different model.

matrix.matched_arms: ny in {48, 96} x nu_lo/nu_hi in {2, 4}, width 2, harmonic mixing, G = 4e-6 (identical to the round-1 M1 matrix so the frozen and evolving arms are compared arm by arm), mobility 1e-2, sigma 0.1, dt 1
matrix.advective_stress_arm: ny=96, ratio 2, G = 4e-5 (Ma ~ 0.05, 10x the matched force), reported against the Stokes reference and used only as an informational stress test (not gated)
matrix.shear_translation: ny in {32, 64}, nx in {64, 128}, slope 0.2, gamma 0.01, total time 200 (dt 1 then dt 1/2), M = 0
